title: Combat Statistics Fix (unofficial) [Beta]
description:
Unofficial fix for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781790213]Combat Statistics[/url] by [i]Blackdevil[/i]. All credit goes to the original author.

Like the original mod, this only works on the public-beta branch for now.
It's only an extension, so the original mod is required. It doesn't affect gameplay, and in multiplayer the other players don't need it.

[b]What it fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The Continue button on the defeat and victory screens, broken since [i]The Fool[/i] update ([i]v0.113[/i]) in November 2026
[*]Combat stats only showing for the first fight of each game launch, with certain other mods installed ([i]Into the Spireverse[/i], for example)
[*][i]Osty[/i] and damage from powers and relics not being tracked, since [i]v0.113[/i]
[*][i]Wuppy[/i]'s absorbed damage not being tracked, new since [i]v0.113[/i]
[/list]

The code is public here: [url=https://github.com/jciurc/sts2-combat-stats-fix]github.com/jciurc/sts2-combat-stats-fix[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[i]Version: 0.2.0
Mod ID: CombatStatisticsFix
Author: symphony[/i]
changeNote: 0.2.0: first release. Fixes the Continue button and missing Osty and damage-source stats on game v0.113 and later, and the overlay showing only for the first fight, and adds Wuppy's stats.
